# `import-boundary`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an import denied by a project contract in `zig-analyzer.json`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Declared dependency direction prevents transport and other outer layers from
leaking into analysis code.

## When it fires

Only configured source and denied path prefixes are matched; no architectural
boundary is guessed from directory names.
